New Features
Performance Improvements & Lower RAM Usage
This release is all about speed. I went through the whole app to find out where time and memory were wasted and rewrote large parts of the image pipeline:
Faster Library: Thumbnails load much faster and scrolling through big folders feels smoother.
Faster Editing: Previews update quicker while moving sliders, and preset previews render much faster.
Faster Exports: Exports finish noticeably faster and use less RAM. Two new Advanced settings let you choose how many images are exported at the same time and…
Faster Batch Actions: Pasting adjustments, resetting and auto lens correction across many images are now much quicker.
